structured_output.world_model:
W6 after E048. Time is about 0.1 s fixed plus steps times per-step cost. Per-step cost has a pixel-proportional compute part and a bandwidth-bound part (BN/GELU/pointwise, ~27% of a 32 px step). Tip E036 reads 5.31 s and 0.7532 on seeds 0-2. Same-commit rebuilds read 0.7525, 0.7497 and 0.7544, so 3-seed noise is ±0.2 pp. The population mean is about 0.752.

Mechanisms:
1. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade at about 1.5-2.5 s/pp and are not free.
2. Early low resolution is nearly free. The 32 px tail carries accuracy.
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, and late freezes are roughly neutral.
4. Averaging, LS and warm-up tweaks are null.
5. Math-identical systems work is worth 1-2% each.
6. Changes that cut full-resolution memory traffic (I080) are the most plausible remaining time lever. Their accuracy risk is real, because stride-2 conv replaces max-pool and loses the pooling nonlinearity.
7. Compile determinism diagnostics (I079) should not change time much. Nondeterminism most likely comes from cuDNN wgrad atomics and autotune choice.

forecasts.reason: Likely within-build is non-bit-identical because of cuDNN atomics. No-cudagraphs costs time, and a shipped cache is probably disallowed or not bit-pinning.

The stem saving is real, since it drops the 31x31 pool input and its backward. The strided conv has a different receptive field and loses the max-pool nonlinearity, so the accuracy cost is likely 0.1-0.4 pp.
The top-ups and the selection roughly cancel on time and accuracy, so the result stays within noise of E036.
A longer group-2 freeze saves about 0.1 s more, at a small accuracy cost that is hard to resolve from noise.

cruxes: Is the tip's true population mean about 0.752 or about 0.7535? Every time-trading idea depends on it.
Does replacing conv1+max-pool with a stride-2 conv lose less than 0.15 pp? If so, the stem's full-resolution memory traffic is the last cheap time lever.
Can the build-to-build spread of 0.2-0.3 pp be removed, for example by pinning autotune? If not, sub-0.15 pp keep decisions are coin flips.
